meta_description: OpenDrone pre-order rounds. Explore the batches, prices and ship dates. Shops can apply for wholesale.
title: Pre-orders
targets_line: One order ships in one parcel, when its last item is ready. Want the {{stock_lines}} in {month}? Order them separately.
targets_line_stock: One order ships in one parcel, when its last item is ready. Want the {{stock_lines}} now? Order them separately.
empty_newsletter_title: Get the next batch by email
faq_a_cancel: Any time before delivery. Full refund. [Withdrawal form](/en/herroepingsrecht#withdraw)
faq_a_missed: Yes. It is confirmed and goes ahead however many people order. Every pre-order ships with it, at the price paid and on the dates in its order confirmation.
faq_q_eta: What if the ship date moves?
faq_a_eta: We email you the new date. You choose a refund or to wait. No reply within 30 days: we refund you. You can still cancel any time before delivery.
faq_a_shops: To the countries listed at checkout. Shipping is confirmed before you pay. EU prices include VAT; US prices include duties; elsewhere, import VAT and duties are paid by the buyer on delivery. Shops can [apply for wholesale access](/wholesale).
